name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 7 leads at a $249.18 CPL, but the strongest recent signal is a 50% week-over-week leads increase paired with a 50.08% CPL drop, likely driven by Meta's 7 leads converting more efficiently as Google Ads spend pulled back 32.28%. Separately, the "Quality HVAC by Fibid" GBP profile is a concern, logging 187 impressions across 24 days but zero calls, warranting an immediate profile audit.

performance.verdict: CPL improving but volume too thin; 6 overdue milestones block any scale.

findings.text: CPL fell 50% week-over-week to an implied ~$125, but only 7 leads in 28 days means each single lead swings CPL wildly — efficiency signal is statistically fragile.
6 SOW milestones are overdue (oldest: Booking bot, 2026-07-31); intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat, blocking any budget scale-up.
LSA re-enable (heating toggles) was due 2026-09-01 — now 10 days overdue. No LSA leads appear in the 28-day data during the transition window.
'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP logged 187 impressions over 24 days but 0 calls and 0 directions — profile likely missing phone/CTA or suppressed by a duplicate signal.

GBP actions, search clicks, and IG reach all collapsed in the last 4 days of the series (sc_clicks = 0 for 4 consecutive days through 2026-09-10) — 3-day signal is a confirmed organic/local drop, not noise.

suggestions.text: Audit 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP profile: verify phone number, CTA button, and duplicate suppression — profile shows 187 impressions, 0 calls.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' profile recorded 187 impressions across 24 days but zero calls and zero directions in the 28-day window. Audit the phone number field, primary category, and check for duplicate-listing suppression in GBP. Success is confirmed when calls > 0 for 3 consecutive days with impressions present. Re-check by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner replacing Vivian, verify GHL login active, and test after-hours automation — blocks all budget scale-up per SOW gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and intake ownership has not been confirmed as of 2026-09-11, which is a hard blocker on raising any ad budgets per the SOW scale-up gate. Identify the replacement owner, confirm their GHL login is active, and send a test lead through the speed-to-lead automation to verify it routes correctly. Success is a confirmed name, active login, and successful test lead by 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days — only 7 leads in 28 days makes the 50% CPL drop statistically fragile; hold budgets until volume confirms.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 7 leads over 28 days with CPL falling 50% week-over-week to an implied ~$125, but the sample is too small to confirm efficiency. Hold current Meta spend (~$24–35/day) unchanged and monitor whether leads continue to arrive without CPL reverting. Success signal is 3+ additional leads at CPL below $200 by 2026-09-14.
